unit.title: A new group, a real connection
unit.titleZh: 第一次见面，不用一直找话题
canDo: Join a gathering and find a shared interest
Recognise an obligation and a tentative assumption
Follow friendly teasing without treating it as criticism

example.py: zhōu mò de jù huì zài wǒ jiā .
example.en: The get-together this weekend is at my place.

vocabulary.usageNote: [GF2021:L4:4521] Source entry: 聚会; jùhuì; 动、名. The lesson teaches this stated sense; minimum-level lookup remains separate.

example.py: tā chēng zàn wǒ zuò de dàn gāo , shuō hái xiǎng zài chī yī kuài .
example.en: She complimented my cake and said she wanted another slice.

vocabulary.usageNote: [GF2021:L4:948] Source entry: 称赞; chēngzàn; 动. The lesson teaches this stated sense; minimum-level lookup remains separate.

example.en: Judging by your expression, don’t you like this dish?

example.en: Could you explain why we need to change the venue?

grammar.explanation: Read 得 as děi here: the speaker needs to do something. The complement marker 得 is de and occupies a different position.

examples.py: wǒ děi xiān huí jiā ná dàn gāo .
examples.en: I have to go home and pick up the cake first.

examples.zh: 明天得早点走，不然会迟到。
examples.py: míng tiān děi zǎo diǎn zǒu , bù rán huì chí dào .
examples.en: We need to leave early tomorrow or we’ll be late.

commonMistakes.why: Modal 得 goes before the action; 得 after a verb has another function.

grammar.explanation: 人家 can refer to another person or household already understood in the conversation. It is informal; use a name when the referent could be unclear.

examples.zh: 人家请我们吃饭，我们别迟到。
examples.py: rén jiā qǐng wǒ men chī fàn , wǒ men bié chí dào .
examples.en: They invited us to dinner; let’s not be late.

examples.zh: 你先问问人家愿不愿意。
examples.py: nǐ xiān wèn wèn rén jiā yuàn bù yuàn yì .

commonMistakes.wrong: 人家请我们，所以所有人都愿意。
commonMistakes.right: 人家请我们，我们按时到吧。
commonMistakes.why: An invitation refers to this host; it does not state everyone’s preference.

grammar.purpose: Challenge an assumption without asserting its opposite
grammar.explanation: 未必 means not necessarily. It leaves the result open; it does not mean definitely not.

examples.zh: 安静的人未必不喜欢聚会。
examples.py: ān jìng de rén wèi bì bù xǐ huān jù huì .
examples.en: Quiet people don’t necessarily dislike get-togethers.

examples.zh: 带礼物未必需要花很多钱。
examples.py: dài lǐ wù wèi bì xū yào huā hěn duō qián .
examples.en: Bringing a gift doesn’t necessarily require spending a lot.

commonMistakes.wrong: 她未必不来，所以她一定来。
commonMistakes.right: 她未必不来，我们再问问。
commonMistakes.why: Not necessarily absent does not guarantee attendance.

grammar.purpose: Describe a result that reverses expectation
grammar.explanation: Give the expectation first and use 反而 for the surprising opposite tendency. It is more specific than a general 而且 addition.

examples.zh: 我原来怕冷场，见面以后反而聊个不停。
examples.py: wǒ yuán lái pà lěng chǎng , jiàn miàn yǐ hòu fǎn ér liáo gè bù tíng .
examples.en: I feared the conversation would dry up, but we couldn’t stop talking once we met.

examples.zh: 我以为他会生气，他反而笑了。
examples.py: wǒ yǐ wéi tā huì shēng qì , tā fǎn ér xiào le .
examples.en: I thought he’d be angry; instead he laughed.

commonMistakes.wrong: 他喜欢这道菜，反而又吃了一碗。
commonMistakes.right: 他喜欢这道菜，所以又吃了一碗。
commonMistakes.why: Eating more is an expected consequence here, so 所以 fits better.

dialogue.title: 第一次见面，不用一直找话题
dialogue.titleZh: 第一次见面，不用一直找话题
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你今晚也去林安家的聚会吗？
lines.py: nǐ jīn wǎn yě qù lín ān jiā de jù huì ma ?
lines.en: Are you going to the get-together at Lin An’s tonight too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 去，不过除了你，我谁都不认识。
lines.py: qù , bù guò chú le nǐ , wǒ shéi dōu bù rèn shi .
lines.en: Yes, but I don’t know anyone except you.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 别担心，我先介绍你们认识。你几点能到？
lines.py: bié dān xīn , wǒ xiān jiè shào nǐ men rèn shi . nǐ jǐ diǎn néng dào ?
lines.en: Don’t worry, I’ll introduce you first. What time can you get there?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 六点吧。我得先回家拿蛋糕。
lines.py: liù diǎn ba . wǒ děi xiān huí jiā ná dàn gāo .
lines.en: Around six. I have to go home and pick up the cake first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你还做了蛋糕？人家肯定很高兴。
lines.py: nǐ hái zuò le dàn gāo ? rén jiā kěn dìng hěn gāo xìng .
lines.en: You made a cake too? They’ll be delighted.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 别先称赞我，可能没有上次那么好吃。
lines.py: bié xiān chēng zàn wǒ , kě néng méi yǒu shàng cì nà me hǎo chī .
lines.en: Don’t compliment me yet. It might not be as good as last time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，那我吃完再说。对了，有个朋友也喜欢你说的那个乐队。
lines.py: hǎo , nà wǒ chī wán zài shuō . duì le , yǒu gè péng you yě xǐ huān nǐ shuō de nà gè yuè duì .
lines.en: Fine, I’ll say something after I try it. By the way, one of the friends likes that band you mentioned too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 真的？那我们至少有个共同话题了。
lines.py: zhēn de ? nà wǒ men zhì shǎo yǒu gè gòng tóng huà tí le .
lines.en: Really? Then we’ve got at least one topic in common.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你不想说话的时候，安静听着也行，不用一直找话题。
lines.py: nǐ bù xiǎng shuō huà de shí hou , ān jìng tīng zhe yě xíng , bù yòng yì zhí zhǎo huà tí .
lines.en: When you don’t feel like talking, it’s fine to just listen. You don’t have to keep finding topics.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你越这么说，我反而越紧张。
lines.py: nǐ yuè zhè me shuō , wǒ fǎn ér yuè jǐn zhāng .
lines.en: The more you say that, the more nervous I get.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，我不说了。你按时来就好，我在门口等你。
lines.py: xíng , wǒ bù shuō le . nǐ àn shí lái jiù hǎo , wǒ zài mén kǒu děng nǐ .
lines.en: Okay, I’ll stop. Just come on time; I’ll wait at the door.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。蛋糕要是不好吃，你可别当着大家的面说。
lines.py: hǎo . dàn gāo yào shì bù hǎo chī , nǐ kě bié dāng zhe dà jiā de miàn shuō .
lines.en: Okay. If the cake tastes bad, don’t say so in front of everyone.
lines.speaker: b

choices: An introduction and someone to meet at the door
A change to the gathering date
questions.answer: An introduction and someone to meet at the door

questions.q: Why must the guest go home first?
What does the guest’s final request suggest?
choices: They’re joking but feel self-conscious about the cake
They plan to buy a different cake instead
They have already tried everyone else’s cake
questions.answer: They’re joking but feel self-conscious about the cake

reading.title: 第一次见面，不用一直找话题
reading.titleZh: 第一次见面，不用一直找话题
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 搬到新城市以后，我最不适应的是下班后的安静。以前想吃饭，随时都能找到朋友。现在手机里有很多名字，却不知道该联系谁。
lines.py: bān dào xīn chéng shì yǐ hòu , wǒ zuì bù shì yīng de shì xià bān hòu de ān jìng . yǐ qián xiǎng chī fàn , suí shí dōu néng zhǎo dào péng you . xiàn zài shǒu jī lǐ yǒu hěn duō míng zi , què bù zhī dào gāi lián xì shéi .
lines.en: After moving to a new city, I struggled most with the quiet evenings after work. I used to be able to find friends for dinner whenever I wanted. Now there were lots of names in my phone, but I didn’t know whom to contact.

lines.zh: 星期五，邻居问我要不要去她家的聚会。我答应了，到了门口却有点紧张：如果大家没有共同话题，怎么办？
lines.py: xīng qī wǔ , lín jū wèn wǒ yào bù yào qù tā jiā de jù huì . wǒ dā yìng le , dào le mén kǒu què yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng : rú guǒ dà jiā méi yǒu gòng tóng huà tí , zěn me bàn ?
lines.en: On Friday my neighbour invited me to a get-together at her place. I accepted, but at the door I felt nervous: what if we had nothing in common to talk about?

lines.zh: 她先介绍我认识另一个新搬来的朋友。我们都带了一盒自己做的点心，看见对方手里的盒子，反而一起笑了。
lines.py: tā xiān jiè shào wǒ rèn shi lìng yī gè xīn bān lái de péng you . wǒ men dōu dài le yī hé zì jǐ zuò de diǎn xīn , kàn jiàn duì fāng shǒu lǐ de hé zi , fǎn ér yì qǐ xiào le .
lines.en: She introduced me to another friend who’d recently moved here. We’d both brought a box of homemade snacks. When we saw each other’s boxes, we laughed.

lines.zh: 一开始，我们聊家乡的天气和吃的东西。后来，他说自己周末常去听音乐，我才发现我们喜欢同一个乐队。
lines.py: yī kāi shǐ , wǒ men liáo jiā xiāng de tiān qì hé chī de dōng xi . hòu lái , tā shuō zì jǐ zhōu mò cháng qù tīng yīn yuè , wǒ cái fā xiàn wǒ men xǐ huān tóng yī gè yuè duì .
lines.en: At first we talked about the weather and food in our hometowns. Then he said he often went to hear music at weekends, and I discovered we liked the same band.

lines.zh: 那天我没有和每个人都聊很久。有一段时间，我只是坐着听。主人没催我说话，也没有问我为什么沉默。
lines.py: nà tiān wǒ méi yǒu hé měi gè rén dōu liáo hěn jiǔ . yǒu yī duàn shí jiān , wǒ zhǐ shì zuò zhe tīng . zhǔ rén méi cuī wǒ shuō huà , yě méi yǒu wèn wǒ wèi shén me chén mò .
lines.en: I didn’t talk at length with everyone that day. For a while I simply sat and listened. The host didn’t push me to speak or ask why I was quiet.

lines.zh: 走的时候，我们互相留了号码，约好下周去听音乐。回家的路上，我突然觉得这座城市没那么陌生了。
lines.py: zǒu de shí hou , wǒ men hù xiāng liú le hào mǎ , yuē hǎo xià zhōu qù tīng yīn yuè . huí jiā de lù shàng , wǒ tū rán jué de zhè zuò chéng shì méi nà me mò shēng le .
lines.en: Before leaving, we exchanged numbers and arranged to hear music together the following week. On the way home, the city suddenly felt less unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 后来我主动请邻居来吃饭。她称赞我的菜，我解释说是照着妈妈教的做的。我们又多了一个能聊的话题。
lines.py: hòu lái wǒ zhǔ dòng qǐng lín jū lái chī fàn . tā chēng zàn wǒ de cài , wǒ jiě shì shuō shì zhào zhe mā mā jiào de zuò de . wǒ men yòu duō le yī gè néng liáo de huà tí .
lines.en: Later I invited my neighbour to dinner. She complimented my food, and I explained that I’d made it the way my mum taught me. We had another topic to talk about.

lines.zh: 现在我知道，交朋友未必需要很多漂亮的话。按时赴约，记住对方说过的小事，有时候比不停地说更重要。
lines.py: xiàn zài wǒ zhī dào , jiāo péng yǒu wèi bì xū yào hěn duō piào liàng de huà . àn shí fù yuē , jì zhù duì fāng shuō guò de xiǎo shì , yǒu shí hou bǐ bù tíng de shuō gèng zhòng yào .
lines.en: Now I know that making friends doesn’t necessarily require lots of impressive words. Showing up on time and remembering little things someone told you can matter more than talking nonstop.

choices: A new city starts feeling less unfamiliar
They decide to stop meeting people
They immediately know everyone in the city
questions.answer: A new city starts feeling less unfamiliar

questions.q: What shared interest do the two newcomers discover?
What helped the narrator feel comfortable?
choices: The host allowed them to listen quietly
The host required them to give a speech
questions.answer: The host allowed them to listen quietly

extraReadings.title: Two cakes at the door
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 这盒也是蛋糕？
lines.py: zhè hé yě shì dàn gāo ?
lines.en: Is that box a cake too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。你不会也带了吧？
lines.py: duì . nǐ bù huì yě dài le ba ?
lines.en: Yes. Don’t tell me you brought one too?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 带了。我做了两个小时，路上还怕没人喜欢。
lines.py: dài le . wǒ zuò le liǎng gè xiǎo shí , lù shàng hái pà méi rén xǐ huān .
lines.en: I did. I spent two hours making it and worried on the way that nobody would like it.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那正好，我们互相称赞一下。
lines.py: nà zhèng hǎo , wǒ men hù xiāng chēng zàn yī xià .
lines.en: Perfect. We can compliment each other’s.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 还没吃呢，你这称赞也太早了。
lines.py: hái méi chī ne , nǐ zhè chēng zàn yě tài zǎo le .
lines.en: We haven’t eaten yet. That’s a bit early for compliments.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我先称赞你的盒子。挺漂亮的。
lines.py: wǒ xiān chēng zàn nǐ de hé zi . tǐng piào liàng de .
lines.en: I’ll compliment your box first. It’s pretty.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 谢谢。这是昨天买的。蛋糕才是今天做的。
lines.py: xiè xiè . zhè shì zuó tiān mǎi de . dàn gāo cái shì jīn tiān zuò de .
lines.en: Thanks. I bought it yesterday. The cake’s the part I made today.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我们先找把刀。再不切，大家只能看盒子了。
lines.py: nà wǒ men xiān zhǎo bǎ dāo . zài bù qiè , dà jiā zhǐ néng kàn hé zi le .
lines.en: Then let’s find a knife. If we don’t cut them, people can only admire the boxes.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: Why is the early compliment funny?
choices: Neither person has tasted the cake yet
questions.answer: Neither person has tasted the cake yet

extraReadings.title: A new group, a real connection: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 第一次见面，不用一直找话题 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 周末的聚会在我家。
lines.py: zhōu mò de jù huì zài wǒ jiā .
lines.en: The get-together this weekend is at my place.

lines.zh: 聚会结束后，我和新朋友交换了号码。
lines.py: jù huì jié shù hòu , wǒ hé xīn péng you jiāo huàn le hào mǎ .
lines.en: After the get-together I exchanged numbers with a new friend.

lines.zh: 她称赞我做的蛋糕，说还想再吃一块。
lines.py: tā chēng zàn wǒ zuò de dàn gāo , shuō hái xiǎng zài chī yī kuài .
lines.en: She complimented my cake and said she wanted another slice.

lines.zh: 老师称赞了我们的表演。
lines.py: lǎo shī chēng zàn le wǒ men de biǎo yǎn .
lines.en: The teacher praised our performance.

lines.zh: 他沉默了一会儿，才说起昨天的事。
lines.py: tā chén mò le yī huì er , cái shuō qǐ zuó tiān de shì .
lines.en: He was silent for a moment before talking about yesterday.

lines.zh: 大家忽然都沉默了，我不知道该说什么。
lines.py: dà jiā hū rán dōu chén mò le , wǒ bù zhī dào gāi shuō shén me .
lines.en: Everyone suddenly fell silent and I didn’t know what to say.

lines.zh: 看你的表情，你是不是不喜欢这道菜？
lines.py: kàn nǐ de biǎo qíng , nǐ shì bú shì bù xǐ huān zhè dào cài ?
lines.en: Judging by your expression, don’t you like this dish?

lines.zh: 他的表情很认真，可他说的其实是玩笑话。
lines.py: tā de biǎo qíng hěn rèn zhēn , kě tā shuō de qí shí shì wán xiào huà .
lines.en: He looked serious, but what he said was actually a joke.

lines.zh: 我误会你的意思了，对不起。
lines.py: wǒ wù huì nǐ de yì si le , duì bù qǐ .
lines.en: I misunderstood you. Sorry.

lines.zh: 这次误会说开以后，我们反而更了解彼此了。
lines.py: zhè cì wù huì shuō kāi yǐ hòu , wǒ men fǎn ér gèng liǎo jiě bǐ cǐ le .
lines.en: Once we cleared up this misunderstanding, we understood each other better.

lines.zh: 你能解释一下为什么要换地方吗？
lines.py: nǐ néng jiě shì yī xià wèi shén me yào huàn dì fāng ma ?
lines.en: Could you explain why we need to change the venue?

lines.zh: 她解释了半天，我才发现是自己看错了日期。
lines.py: tā jiě shì le bàn tiān , wǒ cái fā xiàn shì zì jǐ kàn cuò le rì qī .
lines.en: After she explained for ages, I realised I’d read the date wrong.

lines.zh: 我原来怕冷场，见面以后反而聊个不停。
lines.py: wǒ yuán lái pà lěng chǎng , jiàn miàn yǐ hòu fǎn ér liáo gè bù tíng .
lines.en: I’d worried the conversation would dry up, but once we met we couldn’t stop talking.

lines.zh: 他没有生气，反而笑了。
lines.py: tā méi yǒu shēng qì , fǎn ér xiào le .
lines.en: He didn’t get angry; he laughed instead.

lines.zh: 请按时到，大家一起做饭。
lines.py: qǐng àn shí dào , dà jiā yì qǐ zuò fàn .
lines.en: Please arrive on time; we’re cooking together.

lines.zh: 我今天按时到了，主人却还没回来。
lines.py: wǒ jīn tiān àn shí dào le , zhǔ rén què hái méi huí lái .
lines.en: I arrived on time today, but the host wasn’t back yet.

lines.zh: 我们性格不太一样，但都喜欢看电影。
lines.py: wǒ men xìng gé bù tài yī yàng , dàn dōu xǐ huān kàn diàn yǐng .
lines.en: Our personalities are quite different, but we both like films.

lines.zh: 她的性格和她姐姐很不一样。
lines.py: tā de xìng gé hé tā jiě jie hěn bù yī yàng .
lines.en: Her personality is very different from her sister’s.

lines.zh: 我主动问她要不要一起去买菜。
lines.py: wǒ zhǔ dòng wèn tā yào bù yào yì qǐ qù mǎi cài .
lines.en: I took the initiative and asked whether she wanted to buy groceries together.

lines.zh: 下课后，他主动过来跟我打招呼。
lines.py: xià kè hòu , tā zhǔ dòng guò lái gēn wǒ dǎ zhāo hū .
lines.en: After class he came over to say hello first.

lines.zh: 刚才那个话题我不太了解。
lines.py: gāng cái nà gè huà tí wǒ bù tài liǎo jiě .
lines.en: I don’t know much about the topic you were just discussing.

lines.zh: 我们从天气聊到了音乐，话题越来越多。
lines.py: wǒ men cóng tiān qì liáo dào le yīn yuè , huà tí yuè lái yuè duō .
lines.en: We went from weather to music and found more and more to talk about.

lines.zh: 我们有一个共同的朋友。
lines.py: wǒ men yǒu yī gè gòng tóng de péng you .
lines.en: We have a friend in common.

lines.zh: 这个决定是大家共同作出的。
lines.py: zhè gè jué dìng shì dà jiā gòng tóng zuò chū de .
lines.en: Everyone made this decision together.

lines.zh: 这座城市给我的第一印象是很安静。
lines.py: zhè zuò chéng shì gěi wǒ de dì yī yìn xiàng shì hěn ān jìng .
lines.en: My first impression of this city was how quiet it was.

lines.zh: 我对他的印象变了：他比我想的热情。
lines.py: wǒ duì tā de yìn xiàng biàn le : tā bǐ wǒ xiǎng de rè qíng .
lines.en: My impression of him changed: he’s friendlier than I thought.

lines.zh: 我们互相介绍了自己的家乡。
lines.py: wǒ men hù xiāng jiè shào le zì jǐ de jiā xiāng .
lines.en: We told each other about our hometowns.

lines.zh: 搬家那天，邻居们互相帮忙。
lines.py: bān jiā nà tiān , lín jū men hù xiāng bāng máng .
lines.en: On moving day, the neighbours helped each other.

lines.zh: 刚搬到这里，我还在适应新的生活。
lines.py: gāng bān dào zhè lǐ , wǒ hái zài shì yìng xīn de shēng huó .
lines.en: I’ve just moved here and I’m still adjusting to my new life.

lines.zh: 我花了两个月才适应这里的天气。
lines.py: wǒ huā le liǎng gè yuè cái shì yìng zhè lǐ de tiān qì .
lines.en: It took me two months to get used to the weather here.

lines.zh: 她很热情，一进门就问我要不要喝茶。
lines.py: tā hěn rè qíng , yī jìn mén jiù wèn wǒ yào bù yào hē chá .
lines.en: She was very welcoming and offered me tea as soon as I came in.

lines.zh: 大家对这个计划很热情，马上开始讨论。
lines.py: dà jiā duì zhè gè jì huà hěn rè qíng , mǎ shàng kāi shǐ tǎo lùn .
lines.en: Everyone was enthusiastic about the plan and immediately started discussing it.

turns.text: 你现在想说话还是听一会儿？

turns.meaning: Would you like to talk now or listen for a while?

natural.py: wǒ jiè shào nǐ men rèn shi ba .

pragmatics.note: A concrete offer helps a newcomer more than repeatedly telling them not to feel nervous.

natural.zh: 我不是那个意思。我说清楚一点。
natural.py: wǒ bù shì nà gè yì si . wǒ shuō qīng chǔ yī diǎn .
natural.en: That’s not what I meant. Let me explain more clearly.

pragmatics.note: Explain your intended meaning before arguing about the listener’s reaction.

audio.en: Around six. I have to go home and pick up the cake first.

audio.zh: 那天我没有和每个人都聊很久。有一段时间，我只是坐着听。主人没催我说话，也没有问我为什么沉默。
audio.py: nà tiān wǒ méi yǒu hé měi gè rén dōu liáo hěn jiǔ . yǒu yī duàn shí jiān , wǒ zhǐ shì zuò zhe tīng . zhǔ rén méi cuī wǒ shuō huà , yě méi yǒu wèn wǒ wèi shén me chén mò .
audio.en: I didn’t talk at length with everyone that day. For a while I simply sat and listened. The host didn’t push me to speak or ask why I was quiet.

tasks.statement: The host insisted that the narrator speak continually.
